svg.title: Protocols are nested
svg.desc: The DNS query as nested boxes: the Ethernet frame carries an IPv4 packet, which carries a UDP datagram, which carries the DNS message. Each layer is a header followed by the next layer.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
